2653-2893-6664-8336.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Amanda Grayson trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Amanda Grayson trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

512-3043-5475.easyPrerequisites: Axebane Guardian and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-3043-5475.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with defender.
512-3043-5475.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Forensic Researcher and Axebane Guardian, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-3043-5475.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Axebane Guardian's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

620-1429-2099.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

1643-2073-5147-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Clown Car from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Clown Car enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Clown Car to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Clown Car.
When Clown Car dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

301-2813-4419.easyPrerequisites: There's an artifact on the battlefield.
301-2813-4419.description:
Activate Goblin Trashmaster by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve the Goblin Trashmaster ability.
Repeat.

2104-4823-7370.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Timeless Witness.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Timeless Witness from exile to the battlefield.
When Timeless Witness enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

676-3259-5434.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
676-3259-5434.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Magnus the Red, triggering Breath of Fury and Magnus the Red.
Resolve the Magnus the Red trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2724-3987-5900.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Lilysplash Mentor. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

851-1563-1879-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

188-7124.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Incredible Hulk.
188-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate The Incredible Hulk by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to it.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, untapping it and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

112-4084-6496.manaNeeded: {10}{U}{U}{U}{U} the first turn with {9}{U}{U}{U} each other turn
112-4084-6496.easyPrerequisites: You've cast exactly one spell this turn.
112-4084-6496.description:
Cast Part the Waterveil by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Part the Waterveil and exiling the original Part the Waterveil with four time counters on it.
Resolve the Part the Waterveil copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Part the Waterveil and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Repeat step 4 one additional time.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Part the Waterveil's suspend ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Part the Waterveil and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Part the Waterveil's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.
112-4084-6496.notes: You can use Clockspinning as a way to cast a spell before starting the combo if needed. Since you need to ensure Part the Waterveil is always the second spell cast each extra turn after Clockspinning, it is recommended to not have any other suspended cards when beginning the combo. Otherwise, you can ensure Part the Waterveil is second by casting Clockspinning with the other suspend abilities on the stack during your upkeep.

232-1946-7070.description:
Activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Priest of Urabrask.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Priest of Urabrask.
The Nomads en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1395-2854-3200-4574.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1395-2854-3200-4574.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Showdown of the Skalds trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Urza's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1479-5700-5701-6517-6763.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5700-5701-6517-6763.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

413-2060-3054-6701.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
413-2060-3054-6701.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
When Oathsworn Vampire enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
413-2060-3054-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

325-2498-5014-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-2498-5014-6282.description:
Activate Putrid Imp by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Putrid Imp ability.
Repeat.

1251-1563-2457-4365.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

974-1558-5446.notablePrerequisites:
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
An opponent cannot block and kill Esika's Chariot.
974-1558-5446.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Esika's Chariot's crew ability by tapping the Smaug token, causing Esika's Chariot to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Esika's Chariot as an attacker.
Esika's Chariot's second ability triggers, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

874-4211-5660-5943.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
One of the self-sacrificing artifacts must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
874-4211-5660-5943.description:
Cast the self-sacrificing artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Ms. Bumbleflower triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the self-sacrificing artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the self-sacrificing artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it, and paying other costs if necessary.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2034-5551.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
1270-2034-5551.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lazotep Convert, adding {C}{C}.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Repeat from step 4.

618-957-3662-4836.manaNeeded: {8}{U}{U} available the first turn, with {1}{R} each extra turn
618-957-3662-4836.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Izzet Chemister.
Activate the Izzet Chemister token's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Time Stretch from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your end step, Kiki-Jiki triggers, but you cannot sacrifice the Izzet Chemister token due to The Master.
On your next turn, activate the Izzet Chemister token's last ability by paying {1}{R}, tapping it, and sacrificing it, casting the exiled spell without paying its mana cost.
Resolve that spell, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat from step 2 (note that you can divide these steps among your multiple extra turns to reduce the minimum mana required to the amount shown in the prerequisites).

282-4326-4705-4918.notablePrerequisites:
Delina does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Delina and Lightning Runner.
282-4326-4705-4918.description:
Declare Delina and Lightning Runner as attackers, triggering Delina twice and Lightning Runner once.
Resolve a Delina trigger, creating at least one token copy of Multiform Wonder that enters the battlefield tapped and attacking.
When the Multiform Wonder token(s) enter the battlefield, they trigger, causing you to get at least {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat from step 2 for the remaining Delina trigger.
Resolve the Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, each creature token created by Delina triggers, exiling themselves.
Repeat each combat phase.
Once you have infinite {E}, you may target any other creature(s) you control.

3322-4447.notablePrerequisites: Assault Suit attached to Nikya of the Old Ways.
3322-4447.description:
At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, Assault Suit triggers, giving the opponent control of Nikya of the Old Ways until end of turn.
Because the opponent controls Nikya of the Old Ways, they cannot cast noncreature spells during their turn.
During the cleanup step, you regain control of Nikya of the Old Ways.

2018-4053-5231.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature that does not have flying.
2018-4053-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature without flying, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

138-888-1636-4881-5220.notablePrerequisites:
You control creatures that can produce at least {2}{U}{B}{R}.
Sword of Forge and Frontier attached to a creature that can attack and not be blocked.
138-888-1636-4881-5220.description:
Deal combat damage with the creature that Sword of Forge and Frontier is attached to.
Sword of Forge and Frontier triggers.
In response, activate creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{B}{R}.
Activate Tawnos by paying {U}{R} and tapping them, copying the ability of Sword of Forge and Frontier.
Cast Activated Sleeper by paying {2}{B}, choosing not to copy anything.
Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield and dies.
Mortuary and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve Intruder Alarm's trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Resolve Mortuary's trigger, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the copied abiltiy from Sword of Forge and Frontier, exiling Activated Sleeper and one other card from the top of your library, allowing you to play those cards this turn, and allowing yourself to play an extra land this turn.
Repeat from step 3 until there are no more cards left in your library.

122-1545-1734-4050.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability and Trostani.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Fiend Hunter's toughness.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Phyrexian Delver until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Fiend Hunter, adding one mana of any color.
Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Phyrexian Delver from exile to the battlefield.
Phyrexian Delver enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Trostani.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Phyrexian Delver's toughness.
Resolve the Phyrexian Delver trigger, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose three life.
Repeat from step 2.

6-1528-5195.notablePrerequisites: Dual Casting attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness.
6-1528-5195.description:
Cast Vitalize by paying {G}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Vitalize.
 Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Vitalize, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat from step 3.
